scope: primary-source applicability and local design; actual crash/backend acceptance is recorded separately

primary_sources.finding: Start/removal and filesystem archive/extraction use the known container's lifecycle lock. Removal marks that container dead and releases its registered name after cleanup.
primary_sources.application: Reconcile and collect only positively observed immutable carrier IDs with exact ownership and actual absence checks.
primary_sources.limit: This is not settlement proof for a missing unacknowledged create. The delayed-request fixture demonstrates a later original create without replay. Input-upload abort and early start/permit recovery are not accepted by this increment.

primary_sources.finding: A flock belongs to an open file description. Duplicated/forked descriptors share it, and all references must close before it is released.
primary_sources.application: Permanent inode, O_CLOEXEC, nonblocking exclusivity, inode/provider/database readback and a separate producer-death observation.
primary_sources.local_failure: The initial fork-based unit fixture inherited another parallel test's descriptor and temporarily retained its lock. The corrected unit launches a separate executable process and tests actual SIGKILL, zombie visibility and reaping.

primary_sources.finding: Child::kill uses SIGKILL on Unix; Child is not automatically waited on or killed when dropped.
primary_sources.application: The real-process unit owns its direct child and has explicit kill/wait failure-path cleanup. A zombie is not treated as a missing producer.

primary_sources.finding: Reading a WAL database on read-only media requires existing readable WAL/SHM files, permission to create them, or an immutable connection. A retained WAL is part of the database's durable state.
primary_sources.application: The independent fixture observer reads existing crash WAL/SHM through a read-only connection. It uses immutable mode only on a frozen database with no nonempty WAL, and never creates sidecars on the original read-only volume.
primary_sources.local_failure: The first independent reader failed after clean host-service close removed its WAL/SHM. The original failure report remains Unknown; separate maintenance collected that exact fixture and a fresh crash suite verifies the corrected reader.

primary_sources.finding: Large-object intent/chunks/manifest are immutable create-only objects. Existing objects are accepted only after exact size/hash readback, and the manifest publishes last.
primary_sources.application: Reuse the saved generation and reference after producer fencing. Actual partial-upload tests retain the first published chunk's inode/content and verify the completed reference independently.
primary_sources.limit: Local process exit cannot settle old remote requests. Pending image recovery refuses remote storage; the caller must separately fence consumers before stable collection.
